newsitem.title: USA: Airborne Express puts '97 growth at 15-20pc.
newsitem.headline: Airborne Express puts '97 growth at 15-20pc.

text.p: Airborne Express expects to handle 15-20 percent more cargo at Newark International Airport this year compared to 1996, its International regional sales manager,Brian Gillen said.
"1997 looks very positive with a projected growth of about 15-20 percent more cargo moved than last year," he stated.
The carrier handled 475,000 pounds of cargo at Newark airport in January 1997 against 340,000 pounds in the same period 1996.
The company said it handled more electrical equipment and computer parts at the Newark hub than any other commodity in both 1996 and 1997, it expects it will do the same this year.
Airborne said the most frequented gateway both for imports and exports through their Newark hub was Japan and the UK. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
